text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2405550000 — streaming-api p99 latency SLO breach detected (p99 > 3s) for the last 10m. Alert: routing-layer p99=6.2s, p95=420ms. Paging @eng-oncall.

alice (eng-oncall): seeing lots of streaming stalls in traces, tail spikes around 6s. customers reporting partial streams. grabbing logs now.

bob (eng-sre): repro via /v1/stream endpoint locally not happening. suspect infra — possibly GPU throttling. started rolling query across regions.

carlos (eng-runtime): metrics: node-gpu-42 shows GPU util dropouts and repeated clock throttles. KV cache flushes align with stall windows.

dee (eng-ml): any model rollouts recently? model stayed at v1.3.0 for the week. no prompt changes.

eli (infra): NVML alerts in node-gpu-42: many CORRECTABLE ECC events and recurring thermal throttling events at 15:17:02 UTC. attaching dmesg snippet.

eli (infra): ```
[2405550000] kernel: GPU0: ECC corrected (12 events)
[2405550012] nvml: GPU 0: temperature exceeded TGP threshold, reducing clock
[2405550034] nvidia: GPU 0: GPU stall watchdog triggered, resetting compute
```

alice (eng-oncall): that lines up with the p99 spikes. is it isolated to node-gpu-42?

eli (infra): yes, traffic slice on pool-a had 60% routed to that node due to sticky routing. rest of pool looks stable.

carlos (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation: mark node-gpu-42 as draining in routing to stop new sessions and let existing streams fallback to other replicas.

alice (eng-oncall): doing `kubectl annotate node node-gpu-42 routing/drain=true` then `./ops/router evict --node node-gpu-42`

bob (eng-sre): also enabling model-fallback policy for streaming to allow fallback to cpu-variant for in-flight sessions after 2s stall. command: `redwoodctl rollout set-fallback --service streaming-api --timeout 2s --fallback cpu-small`

fiona (product): FYI — two enterprise customers on pool-a might see degraded quality for up to 10m while we evict. notify CS?

george (cust-success): pinged both customers, told them we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA. they asked if this is related to yesterday's smaller fan wobble — they saw transient errors but were told resolved.

carlos (eng-runtime): after cordon/drain we should see p99 drop. also toggled autoscale to add two extra replicas in pool-b.

alice (eng-oncall): drain complete. routing drain logs: 18 sessions migrated, 4 timed out and triggered fallback.

bob (eng-sre): p99 now down to 1.1s, p95 stable at 390ms. continuing to monitor.

eli (infra): I can repro the thermal fan issue via IPMI logs — fan spin rate for node-gpu-42 intermittently drops to 1200RPM causing GPU temperatures to climb to 88C, hitting TGP throttle. scheduling hot-swap or RMA.

dee (eng-ml): notable: KV cache misses increased during the stalls; when GPU throttled compute slowed causing long waits for new key fill. could be contributing to tail.

carlos (eng-runtime): adding a short-term config: tighten streaming watchdog to 1200ms to trigger quicker fallback for stalls >1.2s. will revert after RCA.

alice (eng-oncall): handing off to night on-call @bob in 30m. documenting actions so far: annotated node, evicted sessions, enabled cpu fallback, autoscaled pool-b, increased watchdog sensitivity.

bob (eng-sre): noted, will keep incident open, patch routing to avoid sticky bias towards node-gpu-42 until hardware replaced. also will run `nv-smi --query-ecc --format=csv` across pool to check corrected/uncorrected counts.

eli (infra): queued RMA with vendor; ETA replacement hardware 48h. short-term plan: replace node in rotation with spare host; if spare not available I'll request burst in cloud region.

fiona (product): any customer visible impact timeline we can share?

george (cust-success): told them 10–20 min for mitigation and possible low-quality fallback while we drain — they accepted but want postmortem.

alice (eng-oncall): postmortem owner? volunteering: alice + eli + carlos. will include timeline, mitigations, and plan to prevent future sticky routing to degraded GPUs.

carlos (eng-runtime): suggested longer-term: detect ECC-corrected-rate anomalies and auto-deprioritize node for streaming routing if corrected_rate > X within Y mins. propose X=5/min, Y=10m.

dee (eng-ml): also recommend KV cache warming on fallback replicas to reduce cold-miss penalty. add as Optimize ticket.

bob (eng-sre): current status: incident mitigated, p99 back under SLO, hardware issue scheduled for replacement. keeping this thread open for RCA drafting.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2405550000 — status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev2.

alice (eng-oncall): leaving detailed notes in /incidents/2405550000_rfc in docs. handing off to @bob for overnight watch. :thumbsup:
